blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — In-person classes were suspended in some areas, while several schools adjusted their class schedules on Thursday, Nov. 19, due to the expected dangerous heat. READ: Walang Pasok: High heat index prompts class suspensions on Nov. 3 Below are the affected areas: The Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) forecast a high heat index of 42°C to 51°C in five areas in Mimaropa, the Visayas and Mindanao on Thursday. Pagasa warned that exposure to these conditions increases the risk of heat cramps and heat exhaustion, which could progress to heat stroke. /mcm...
